verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for an AI infrastructure product. However, the evidence only documents control through the dashboard, API, a visual interface, JSON configuration and HTTP headers. The llms.txt and OpenAPI probes are developer building blocks an agent could use, not the product itself accepting natural-language commands, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
